meta_description: Designer Decorators Newcastle. Professional interior and exterior painting, decorating, and wallpapering. Free quotes, honest pricing. Call 07725 647630.
hero_subhead: Transform your home with expert interior and exterior decorating. Free no-obligation quote within 48 hours.
services_subhead: From kitchen refreshes to full home redecorations, we handle interior and exterior projects of any size.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: We refresh living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens and hallways with high-quality emulsion and specialist paints. Proper surface preparation and two coats ensure a finish that lasts.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Protect and enhance your home's exterior with weatherproof masonry paint and wood finishes. We prepare surfaces thoroughly and work around your schedule.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Bespoke wallpaper hanging for feature walls or complete rooms. We source quality papers and ensure perfect alignment and seams.

services.title: Woodwork & Skirting
services.desc: Professional painting of doors, frames, skirting boards and shutters. We sand, prime and finish with durable gloss or satin for a smart, lasting look.

services.title: Ceilings & Coving
services.desc: Expert ceiling painting and coving installation to transform dated spaces. We handle awkward heights and tight corners without fuss.

services.title: Commercial Redecorating
services.desc: Offices, retail and hospitality spaces benefit from our professional approach. We work flexibly around business hours to minimise disruption.

about_pullquote: We do one thing right: leave your home looking better than it was.
about_para_1: Designer Decorators was founded in Newcastle over 15 years ago with a simple idea: honest pricing, proper preparation, and lasting results. We've built our reputation on turning tired interiors into homes our customers genuinely love. Every project—whether a one-bed flat or a period Victorian—gets the same meticulous attention to detail.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we listen. We don't oversell, we turn up on time, and we leave your home spotless. We're fully insured and proud members of the local business community. When you call, you speak to someone who knows the North East inside out.

reviews.text: Transformed our lounge from drab to brilliant. The team were polite, tidy, and worked around our two kids without any fuss. Gave us a fair price upfront and stuck to it. Can't fault them really.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had the master bedroom and hallway done. The wallpaper work is immaculate—no bubbles, no wrinkles. They prepped everything properly and cleaned up after themselves each day. Would definitely have them back.
reviews.author: Catherine M.

reviews.text: Called for an exterior quote and they came out the next day. Price was reasonable and the work is holding up beautifully. Professional without being stuffy. Recommended them to our neighbours already.
reviews.author: David L.
